basic_info.description: Experience elevated city living in Residence 856, a stylish one-bedroom plus den with stunning views of Oracle Park, partial Bay vistas, and the city skyline. Widely recognized for its unique layout and spacious design, this residence offers a versatile den area off the kitchen that can be transformed into a dining nook, home office, creative studio, or guest room. The bright, open living and dining space flows seamlessly, the gourmet kitchen includes stainless appliances, the primary suite features a generous walk-in closet with enhanced closet organizers, spa-inspired bath, in-unit washer/dryer, and hardwood floors throughout. Located within The Beacon, residents enjoy premium amenities including a pool/spa, fitness center, lush dog park, 24-hour concierge, and secure parking. Nestled in the vibrant Mission Bay/South Beach area, The Beacon places you close to I-280, Caltrain, Muni, and a variety of shopping, dining, and waterfront attractions, offering both convenience and a connected lifestyle.
